name: paperrelay
description: A local-first library for research artifacts created across projects.

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && pnpm run build:mcp && pnpm run build:relay && pnpm run check:bundle-syntax
scripts.check:bundle-syntax: node --check out/main/index.js && node --check out/preload/index.js && node --check dist/mcp/main.js && node --check dist/relay/paperrelay-relay.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mcp.json
scripts.lint: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:source
scripts.package:prepare: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:package-boundary
scripts.package:win:dir: pnpm run package:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.15.6 --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run package:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.15.6 --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:format && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:package-boundary
scripts.check:release: pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run audit:licenses && pnpm run audit:dependencies
